# Ready.gov

> Ready.gov is FEMA's comprehensive disaster preparedness portal providing guidance on planning, response, and recovery for natural disasters, public health threats, and emergency situations.

Ready.gov serves as the federal government's primary resource for helping Americans prepare for and respond to disasters and emergencies. The site covers natural hazards like hurricanes and floods, human-caused threats like cyberattacks and explosions, and practical safety measures for homes and public spaces. Content is available in English and Spanish, with integration across FEMA systems including the FEMA Mobile App, Emergency Alert System, and disaster assistance resources.

## Key Topics

- Emergency preparedness
- Disaster response
- Natural disasters
- Evacuation planning
- Home safety
- Emergency alerts
- FEMA
- Wireless Emergency Alerts (WEA)
- NOAA Weather Radio
- Emergency planning
- Public safety
- Disaster recovery
- Before-During-After framework
- Family emergency planning
- Shelter-in-place procedures

## Getting Started

- [Plan Ahead for Disasters | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov): Ready.gov homepage: FEMA's main disaster preparedness and emergency planning portal
- [Planifique con anticipación para los desastres | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/es): Spanish-language version of Ready.gov disaster preparedness and emergency planning
- [Disasters and Emergencies | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/be-informed): Guide to understanding disasters, emergency alerts, and family evacuation planning

## Natural Disasters

- [Hurricanes | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/hurricanes): Hurricane preparedness guide covering storm surge, evacuation, and recovery
- [Floods | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/floods): Flood preparedness guide for most common U.S. natural disaster response
- [Earthquakes | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/earthquakes): Earthquake safety guide covering preparation, response, and recovery
- [Extreme Heat | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/heat): Extreme heat safety guide covering prevention and heat-related illness response
- [Drought | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/drought): Drought preparedness and water conservation guide for dry conditions
- [Avalanche | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/avalanche): Avalanche safety guide covering preparation and response for mountain hazards
- [Landslides & Debris Flow | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/landslides-debris-flow): Landslide and debris flow safety guide for mountain and slope hazard areas

## Emergency Alerts & Response

- [Emergency Alerts | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/alerts): How-to guide for receiving emergency alerts via WEA, NOAA, and FEMA App
- [Attacks in Crowded and Public Spaces | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/public-spaces): Preparedness guide for mass attacks using Run, Hide, Fight response tactics

## Security & Health Threats

- [Cybersecurity | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity preparedness guide covering cyberattack prevention and response
- [Biohazard Exposure | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/biohazard): Biological threat preparedness guide for accidental and intentional exposures
- [Explosions | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/explosions): Explosion preparedness guide with DHS and CISA safety recommendations
- [Chemicals and Hazardous Materials Incidents | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/hazmat): Hazmat incident safety guide with shelter-in-place and evacuation procedures

## Home & Personal Safety

- [Home Fires | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/home-fires): Home fire safety guide covering prevention, escape plans, and smoke alarms
- [Home Safety | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/home-safety): Home safety guide for injury prevention, CPR, AED, and first-aid training
- [Household Chemical Emergencies | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/household-chemical-emergencies): Household chemical safety guide with Poison Control and storage recommendations

## Optional

- [Lapse in Federal Funding Impact on FEMA Website Operations Notice | Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/lapse-federal-funding-impact-fema-website-operations-notice): FEMA notice regarding federal funding lapse and website operations impact
